def process(precipChatham, precipAshburnham, precipAmherst, precipBoston):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']

    def clean_one(df: pd.DataFrame, station: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df.copy()
        # keep only year rows (drop summary rows like Max/Min/Mean etc.)
        d['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(d['Year'], errors='coerce')
        d = d[d['Year_num'].notna()].copy()
        d['Year_num'] = d['Year_num'].astype(int)
        d = d[(d['Year_num'] >= 2020) & (d['Year_num'] <= 2023)].copy()

        # coerce month values: treat 'M' as missing
        for m in months:
            d[m] = pd.to_numeric(d[m].replace({'M': np.nan, 'T': np.nan}), errors='coerce')

        long = d.melt(id_vars=['Year_num'], value_vars=months, var_name='Month', value_name='Rain')
        long['station'] = station
        return long

    longAll = pd.concat([
        clean_one(precipChatham, 'Chatham'),
        clean_one(precipAshburnham, 'Ashburnham'),
        clean_one(precipAmherst, 'Amherst'),
        clean_one(precipBoston, 'Boston'),
    ], ignore_index=True)

    # impute missing values with median of that Month across non-missing years (2020-2023) within station
    med = longAll.groupby(['station','Month'])['Rain'].median().reset_index(name='monthMedian')
    longAll = longAll.merge(med, on=['station','Month'], how='left')
    longAll['Rain_imp'] = longAll['Rain'].fillna(longAll['monthMedian'])

    # compute annual total per station/year (sum of imputed monthly values)
    annual = longAll.groupby(['Year_num','station'])['Rain_imp'].sum().reset_index(name='annualRain')
    # average across stations per year
    annualAvg = annual.groupby('Year_num')['annualRain'].mean().reset_index(name='avgAnnualRain')
    annualAvg = annualAvg.sort_values('Year_num')

    # compute year-over-year direction
    annualAvg['rainDelta'] = annualAvg['avgAnnualRain'].diff()
    annualAvg['rainDir'] = annualAvg['rainDelta'].apply(lambda x: None if pd.isna(x) else ('up' if x>0 else ('down' if x<0 else 'flat')))

    return annualAvg.rename(columns={'Year_num':'Year'})

def process(water2020, water2021, water2022, water2023):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = pd.concat([water2020, water2021, water2022, water2023], ignore_index=True)

    # Standardize fields
    df = df.copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    df = df[df['Year'].between(2020, 2023)].copy()

    # Parse Sample Date and extract month
    dt = pd.to_datetime(df['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[dt.notna()].copy()
    df['month'] = dt[dt.notna()].dt.month

    # Fresh water only
    df = df[df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('fresh')].copy()

    # Violation -> boolean exceedance
    viol = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['exceed'] = viol.eq('yes')

    # Monthly exceedance rate per year (mean of boolean)
    monthly = (
        df.groupby(['Year', 'month'])['exceed']
          .mean()
          .reset_index(name='exceedRate')
    )

    # Full grid Year x Month for 2020-2023 x 1-12
    years = pd.DataFrame({'Year': [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023]})
    months = pd.DataFrame({'month': list(range(1, 13))})
    grid = years.assign(_k=1).merge(months.assign(_k=1), on='_k').drop(columns=['_k'])
    monthly = grid.merge(monthly, on=['Year', 'month'], how='left')

    # Impute missing monthly exceedance rates with median of that month across non-missing years
    med = monthly.groupby('month')['exceedRate'].median().reset_index(name='monthMedian')
    monthly = monthly.merge(med, on='month', how='left')
    monthly['exceedRateImp'] = monthly['exceedRate'].fillna(monthly['monthMedian'])

    # Annual exceedance rate: average of monthly rates (after imputation)
    annual = (
        monthly.groupby('Year')['exceedRateImp']
               .mean()
               .reset_index(name='annualExceedRate')
               .sort_values('Year')
    )

    annual['exceedDelta'] = annual['annualExceedRate'].diff()
    annual['exceedDir'] = annual['exceedDelta'].apply(lambda x: None if pd.isna(x) else ('up' if x>0 else ('down' if x<0 else 'flat')))
    return annual
